title: MV How to use parameter arrays

posts.author: SirRule
TobyYasha
posts.body:
Remove the "@type number[]" part and just treat it as a regular string.
Because "number[]" doesn't seem to be supported by the RPG Maker MZ Plugin System.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
type number[] might not work as your default is 3,0
but should output [3,2].
I don't think you need to split the array with a comma when using an array.
arrays are mostly read when you use JSON.parse (same for booleans)
so in your case, remove "type number[]" and use
JSON.parse(parameters['SkillTypeIDs']);
so your default can be [1,3,4,5,6,7,8] to be readed.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I'm pretty sure number[] is also valid in MZ.
Also if you are not sure how to input default value, just input using the editor and copy the text.
Actually it will be converted to a string array. But you can use number input to edit it.
